trial_formulas.reconstruction: reconstruction_scale * byte reconstruction, only when sentence reconstruction is enabled
trial_formulas.expectation: inter_loss_weight * next-sentence MSE + inter_contrastive_weight * InfoNCE; legacy intra is added only when enabled
trial_formulas.structured_expectation: Next-sentence cost = content MSE + presence BCE + kind BCE, each with internal weight 1; the external inter_loss_weight applies to their sum
trial_formulas.supplied_answer: 1 * raw numeric MSE, or band-weighted event error for a supplied text answer; omitted in the cut arm
trial_formulas.grammar_lesson: grammar_lesson_weight * sum of enabled lesson objectives
trial_formulas.row_reduction: Each trial is averaged over active sentence rows before its optimizer step.

batch_formulas.answer_numeric: lossOut uses what_scale for the bandless numeric output
batch_formulas.reconstruction: Owned tied byte loss from the understanding
batch_formulas.truth: Detached luminosity/universality multiplier on the assembled cost, plus independent truth/balance terms
batch_formulas.regularizers: Gate L1 follows truth modulation; readout L1 is a detached report of optimizer-owned proximal regularization
